title: Pasting the second graph side across an open shrinking
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, h:X→Z a scheme map, c=(j,c0) an open-then-proper compactification of h, and H=(a,e,p) a proper/open/proper presentation of h [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data]. Let a':X→W be proper and v:W→H.U open with a' v=a, and write S=(a',v e,p). Define B2_H and B2_S to be the specified second graph-side isomorphisms from F_H and F_S to their second-neighborhood words [def-pur-etale-graph-neighborhood-words]. Let T be the inverse proper/open triangle induced by the open N_S→N_H, followed by the open compositor under the common ambient proper direct image. Let I be the elementary shrinking isomorphism F_H→F_S. Then B2_H followed by T equals I followed by B2_S, as natural transformations on the ordinary unbounded small-etale module derived categories. This assertion contains neither the graph middle map nor the final graph comparison.

source.place: Tag 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition), independence-of-choices part of the proof and the final comparison of diagrams A-F. Agent-stated product-graph extension: unlike the source compatible-tower comparisons, this assertion identifies the concrete graph comparisons for arbitrary proper/open/proper presentations. Elementary presentation move compared with upstream LowerShriekComposition.lean, rightDerivedLowerStarCompOpenImmersionLowerShriekIso and the eh factor in nonempty_iso_rightDerivedLowerShriek_comp. This is a new obligation, not a theorem claimed to be proved by that Lean existence declaration.

proof.text: Use the existing open-shrinking comparison for the presentation H and the open factor v followed by H.e. Normalize its explicit shrinking presentation to H.shrink, and expand each graph comparison from open as graphSide₁, graphMiddle, and the inverse of graphSide₂.

Use the existing middle pasting equality and the definitional first-side identity graphFirstShrinkIso. A generic categorical cancellation lemma, proved privately in this module, cancels the first-side and middle isomorphisms from the expanded comparison equality. The remaining equality is exactly graphSide₂ followed by graphNeighborhoodTriangle equals etaleGraphShrinkInterchange followed by the shrunken graphSide₂.

proof_origin.place: The open-shrink comparison, middle pasting, and categorical cancellation of the common first and middle factors.

lean.statement: theorem etaleGraphShrinkSidePasting (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Z W : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ Z} (c : Compactification h) (H : EtaleGraphPresentation h) (a' : X ⟶ W) (v : W ⟶ H.U) [IsProper a'] [IsOpenImmersion v] (fac : a' ≫ v = H.a) : (H.graphSide₂ c A).hom ≫ (H.graphNeighborhoodTriangle c A a' v fac).hom = (etaleGraphShrinkInterchange A H a' v fac).hom ≫ ((H.shrink a' v fac).graphSide₂ c A).hom
